Research notes & what the older snapshots prove
  • The earliest working directory snapshot is 30 June 2008. January–May 2008 directory records were indexed as HTTP 401 and are not counted as working inventories.
  • No individual pre-2013 BSP/BSP.BZ2 captures were found in the queried NoxiousNet map index. A directory listing is evidence of a filename, not proof of a usable map download at that date.
  • The 69 early capture links represent 63 source files already included in Map downloads. All six additional 2015 captures are now included there too. Their repeated CDX digests are identical, so these are additional dates, not newly discovered map versions.
  • The ten 2016 directory snapshots extend the collection to 31 July 2016, whose listing contains 1,549 map filenames. Later indexed captures through April 2018 are HTTP 403 pages. Their directory listings do not establish new downloadable map binaries.
  • Directory dates and early capture dates were checked against Memento-Datetime on 16 October 2026. File checks read a small binary signature; full-file integrity and in-game behavior were not tested. All dates are UTC and are archive dates, not release dates.
  • The directory collection spans 2008–2016. The complete indexed heavy.noxiousnet.com map-file capture list was reconciled with Map downloads: every indexed BSP/BSP.BZ2 capture is included. A directory filter matches map names, not identical file contents or capture dates. Unindexed captures or off-domain mirrors may still exist.
About the files

BSP is a ready-to-use map file. Extract BSP.BZ2 to BSP. Put maps in GarrysMod/garrysmod/maps. Copy and TXT buttons include every filtered result, not just the current page. Historical inventory exports contain filenames and snapshot references, not unverified download URLs.

About verification

The original 1,478 download links were checked on 15 October 2026; additional captures and directory snapshots were checked on 16 October 2026. The archive may be incomplete and availability can change. Links point to snapshots of the old NoxiousNet server. This HTML includes its data and TXT reports for offline browsing.
